title: Conveying Imagistic Thinking in TCM Translation: A Prompt Engineering and LLM-Based Evaluation Framework
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the translation quality of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) using a prompt-based framework. While it discusses the hermeneutics of ancient medical texts and the imagistic epistemology of TCM, it does not benchmark religious faith, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethics. Instead, it assesses translations based on cognitive dimensions like clarity and clinical transferability.
